description: This file contains constants, functions for parsing command-line arguments, and utility functions related to test argument filtering within a test runner or testing framework.

methods.name: parsePassthroughArgs
methods.description: Parses an array of command-line arguments into file filters and option arguments, handling special cases like '--' and options that require values.

methods.name: countExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Counts how many explicit file filter arguments are provided after the initial arguments.

methods.name: getExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Retrieves the list of explicit file filter arguments from the command-line arguments.
